skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — download this video as an MP4 file I can keep offline — and get downloaded...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Download — Download and Save Videos Locally

- Quickly download and convert online videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) to MP4 for offline use.
- No need for complex editing software — just describe your request in plain language.
- Automatic backend connection and token handling for fast setup (100 free credits, no registration needed).
- Supports exporting at up to 1080p; process typically completes in 20–40 seconds.
- Handles uploads, status checks, credit queries, and video exports—all from a simple chat interface.
- Clear error handling and helpful status updates throughout the process.
